component.name: GEstimator
component.summary: Cost estimates with rate analysis for civil and electrical works

description.p: GEstimator prepares cost and quantity estimates of civil and electrical works with detailed rate analysis. It comes with DSR 2021 (Civil) and DSR (E and M) 2025 and can use other databases of items.

ul.li: Schedule of items, resources and details of measurements in tables with keyboard navigation
Rate analysis editor with undo, bulk editing of analyses and rate updates from databases
Several projects open in tabs, with recovery of unsaved work
Import from and export to Excel workbooks
Optional local MCP server for AI assistants to read and prepare estimates

screenshot.caption: Schedule of an estimate priced from DSR 2023
Rate analysis of a schedule item
Adding items from a bundled database
